guide.bet: Pick a bet amount (per hand). Two hands will be dealt.
guide.switch: You may swap the second card between hand 1 and hand 2.
guide.action: Acting on hand {{idx}}: Hit / Stand / Double Down

rules.summary: You play two hands and may swap the second card between them. In return, blackjacks pay 1:1 and a dealer 22 is a push.

frontendHint.blackjackswitchBet: Place a bet to be dealt two hands
frontendHint.blackjackswitchSwitch: Swapping makes both hands playable — switch
frontendHint.blackjackswitchKeep: Swapping does not improve the pair — keep the deal
frontendHint.blackjackswitchStandPush22: A dealer 22 is a push, so you cannot count on a bust — stand
